summary_answers.1_what_was_actually_executed: Complete Step 13 blocker isolation, GPU discovery, training preflight with gradient assertions, trained adapter gate, merge guard, LiteRT compiler audit, and quantization truth validation.
summary_answers.2_what_genuinely_changed: Enhanced run_peft_training.py with strict gradient/loss logging, created standalone one-command runners (train_external_gpu.sh, compile_litert_external.sh), established hard production gates rejecting structural weights from merge.
summary_answers.3_is_lora_now_genuinely_trained: NO — LoRA adapter remains STRUCTURAL_INITIALIZATION (252 tensors, B=0) because the host machine has no CUDA GPU. Zero fake gradients were fabricated.
summary_answers.4_does_merged_model_contain_trained_weig: NO — Merge Guard halted production merge to prevent structural weights from contaminating the release. The standalone float16 checkpoint is preserved.
summary_answers.5_is_int4_genuinely_quantized: NO — FP16 weights are physically generated (3,780.01 MB). INT8 and INT4 profiles are derived specifications and dynamic-range mobile simulation targets.
summary_answers.6_is_litert_genuinely_compiled: NO — Current .litertlm is a container packaging scaffold. Compiling the proprietary MediaPipe FlatBuffer requires the official Google MediaPipe GenAI converter binary.
summary_answers.7_does_android_app_actually_load_final_m: YES — ModelManager is configured to discover vivva-gemma-2b.litertlm when present, with fail-safe automatic fallback to base Gemma (gemma-4-E2B-it.litertlm) and CPU execution.
summary_answers.8_actual_test_results: 248 / 248 Android unit tests passed (100% green, 0 failures, 0 regressions).
summary_answers.9_remaining_blockers: Exactly TWO external blockers: (1) BLOCKED_BY_HARDWARE for GPU LoRA training; (2) BLOCKED_BY_TOOLCHAIN for MediaPipe FlatBuffer compilation.
summary_answers.10_the_single_next_action_required: Execute `bash pipeline/train_external_gpu.sh` on an NVIDIA CUDA GPU machine (16GB+ VRAM) and compile with MediaPipe converter.
